cut: gathered clay from The clay bank
Started shape (The workbench): At the workbench one piece of clay can become a small bowl worth keeping where I can see it.
shape: finished a small clay bowl
Started watch (perch): From a high place I can see everything that has not yet been claimed by me.
The day's plan has run out and there is still a whole afternoon of things I want, so I will take what remains of the flowers, seeds and clay and fill the rest with dusk and the telescope.
